name: words-with-flies-policy

inputs.game_state: Board/rack/bag/score/turn features encoded by the offline trainer and browser identically.
inputs.candidates: At most 256 legal candidate-play feature rows in deterministic order.
inputs.recurrent_state: Previous recurrent state, reset at the beginning of each game.

outputs.policy_logits: One logit for each candidate row.
outputs.value: Expected game outcome from the fly perspective.
outputs.next_recurrent_state: State carried into the fly's following turn.

invariants: The browser rules engine masks unavailable candidates before selection.
The lexicon SHA-256 and topology SHA-256 are recorded with every trained release.
Only the recorded topology and lexicon inputs are accepted by a trained release.
